description:
What did the Titanic actually look like? For the first time in history, a massive, cutting-edge undersea scanning project has created the first high-res 3D Digital Twin of the Titanic. This unprecedented immersive investigation builds the most detailed model of the wreck ever created, allowing science to reveal the truth about what really happened on that fateful night more than 100 years ago.
